  AUTO_SUSPEND = 60
  AUTO_RESUME = TRUE
  INITIALLY_SUSPENDED = TRUE;

eyebrow: A stage for the daily export
code:
CREATE STAGE IF NOT EXISTS
  DRIFTWOOD_ANALYTICS.SUPPORT.TICKETS_STAGE
  FILE_FORMAT = (
    TYPE = CSV
    FIELD_OPTIONALLY_ENCLOSED_BY = '"'
    SKIP_HEADER = 1
  );
caption: One CSV lands here each day, under a date-partitioned path.
One bad row rejects the whole load, rather than silently loading a partial day.
